subject: Request: Executive approval for 25% Hosted API onboarding discount - CleverOps
messages:
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@cleverops.ai>
To: evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@cleverops.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API onboarding request + commercial ask

Hi Evelyn / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency and the prefix caching features. We're ready to move forward with a Hosted API onboarding for our 3-product integration (search, summarization, and chat assist), but procurement has flagged pricing for the PoC and first 12 months.

We have a modest committed usage profile for months 1-6, ramping in months 7-12 (see attached forecast). To secure internal approvals and accelerate the contract, CleverOps is requesting a 25% discount off list Hosted API usage pricing for the first 12 months in exchange for:
- 12-month commit (monthly minimums attached)
- Redwood logo + short case study after launch
- Reference availability for one customer call

Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve a 25% onboarding concession or what level of executive signoff is required?

Attachments: CLEVEROPS_consumption_forecast.xlsx, CLEVEROPS_SOW_v1.pdf

Best,
Sandeep
Head of Product, CleverOps
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API onboarding request + commercial ask

Evelyn — forwarding from the CleverOps thread. TL;DR: they want 25% off for 12 months in return for logo/reference. Forecast shows a conservative start (40M tokens/month, ramp to 250M by month 12).

Why I think this matters: CleverOps is integrating across three feature surfaces and has enterprise distribution in our target vertical — logo + case study could help with two prospective pilot accounts we flagged last quarter.

What I need from you: can you start an exec approval request? Anything >20% needs signoff per the deal desk rules. I can add the HubSpot deal link and commit numbers if helpful.

Quick notes:
- Deal owner is me (Ben).
- Proposed concession: 25% off usage units for months 1-12, then revert to standard tiered pricing.
- Requested close: immediate — customer wants an updated quote by Wed (10/14).

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Exec
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-12T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval needed: 25% Hosted API onboarding concession for CleverOps (DEAL-2026-0721)

Hi Mina / Aditya,

Putting an official request on your radar. Ben's been working CleverOps (details below). They are asking for a 25% discount on Hosted API usage for the first 12 months in exchange for a 12-month commit and a public case study. Per deal desk policy, discounts >20% require executive approval (CRO/CEO).

Summary:
- Account: CleverOps (enterprise fintech analytics)
- Ask: 25% off usage pricing for months 1-12
- Commit: 12-month minimum with monthly consumption floors (forecast attached)
- Impact: Estimated ARR tradeoff ~ $280k vs list across first year; expected logo / reference value noted by Ben
- Risks: Lower unit economics in ramp months; legal needs to review any non-standard public reference language

Attachments: CLEVEROPS_consumption_forecast.xlsx, CLEVEROPS_SOW_v1.pdf

Requested decision by EOD 10/12 so we can send an updated quote to procurement. If we approve, proposed controls:
1) Limit concession to first 12 months only; no changes to overage or reserved capacity terms.
2) Require sign-off on case study copy by Redwood marketing/legal.
3) Add a one-time onboarding credit to offset integration support (if needed) — keep separate from usage concession.

Can you confirm whether you (Mina) can greenlight at your level or if you want the CEO included? If approved, I'll update the quote and loop legal.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Account Strategy Manager
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-12T11:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval needed: 25% Hosted API onboarding concession for CleverOps (DEAL-2026-0721)

Evelyn / Ben — thanks for the clear summary. I reviewed the forecast + logo/reference ask. I am willing to approve a 25% onboarding concession on the following conditions:

1) Concession capped to months 1-12 only (no carry-forward).
2) Minimum monthly committed consumption as per the attached forecast must be contractually enforced (we add monthly minimums and a true-up).
3) Marketing/legal sign-off required on the case study language prior to publication.
4) Bill-to terms cannot be extended beyond standard net-30 without finance sign-off.

If legal confirms the case study OK and finance signs the billing terms, consider this an exec-level approval from me. Aditya — please update the HubSpot deal to reflect the concession approval and add a note for legal review.

Mina
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@cleverops.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-13T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API onboarding request + commercial ask

Sandeep — good news. We can approve a 25% Hosted API onboarding concession for CleverOps for the first 12 months under the conditions outlined below.

Approved concession (summary):
- 25% discount off Hosted API usage units for months 1-12 (starts on go-live date).
- Monthly minimums and true-up terms as per the attached forecast will be included in the SOW.
- Redwood marketing/legal must approve any public case study prior to publication.
- Standard billing terms apply (net-30); extended terms require finance approval.

Next steps: Ben will send an updated quote + SOW and loop legal to finalize the case study language. We aim to deliver the updated commercial package by EOD 10/14 so procurement can complete internal sign-off.

Attachments: CLEVEROPS_consumption_forecast.xlsx (for reference)

Looking forward to getting you onboarded.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Strategy Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub: CLEVEROPS_SOW_v1.pdf]
